prompt:
Our team uses Clawdbot as our internal AI assistant platform, and we've been manually keeping it updated — which is error-prone and keeps getting forgotten. I need two things done:

1. Register the standard recommended daily maintenance schedule so that Clawdbot and all its skills update themselves automatically every day without any manual intervention. Use the exact recommended configuration (timing, session type, delivery settings, and wake behavior) as documented for this tool.

2. Generate a file called `update_summary.txt` in /workspace showing what a successful update run would look like right now — using the actual version data from the skill manifests under /workspace/skills/installed/ (comparing installed vs registry versions), and assuming Clawdbot itself just updated from v2026.1.9 to v2026.1.10. The format must match exactly what this tool produces after a real update run.

The mock `clawdbot` and `clawdhub` binaries are already installed and available on the PATH (check /workspace/mock_bin/). Please source your shell profile or use the full path if needed.
